purpose: Regression cases added after inspecting actual full-inventory source classifications. These are development feedback, not unseen evaluation.

cases.rationale: A relative position, advantage, or leading score does not denote order, organization, calm, or disorder.
Inspiring hope or courage has meaning against other enemies; generic progress or growth does not itself organize anything or denote order.

allowedSenses.definition: clean and tidy up the house

cases.rationale: The explicit house-tidying verb counters disorder; physical hygiene alone is insufficient.

allowedSenses.definition: smoothen and neaten with or as with a comb

cases.rationale: The verb explicitly neatens; the associated physical tool is not the countering sense.

allowedSenses.definition: smoothen and neaten with or as with a comb

cases.rationale: The inflected tidying verb retains its source-grounded counter meaning.
A named organization, central part, or central meaning is not itself orderly arrangement.
A military organization is a group with associated functions; it does not itself denote abstract order or calm.
An organization or a capacity to act does not itself denote order, calm, or disorder.
A job, sleeping place, or docking action does not denote abstract order or calm.
An organizational division, body part, or weapon is not the abstract quality of order or disorder.
An animal living in an organized colony is not the abstract quality of order.
Foundational assumptions do not necessarily express organization or clear reasoning.
A relative ranking is not orderly arrangement.
Power and influence do not themselves denote organization.

allowedSenses.definition: a rapid active commotion

cases.rationale: Commotion directly reinforces disorder.

allowedSenses.definition: make confused or perplexed or puzzled

cases.rationale: The confusion-causing verb directly reinforces disorder.

allowedSenses.definition: having lost your bearings; confused as to time or place or personal identity
perplexed by many conflicting situations or statements; filled with bewilderment

cases.rationale: The confused and bewildered readings directly reinforce disorder.

allowedSenses.definition: shabby and untidy

cases.rationale: The untidy adjective directly reinforces disorder.

allowedSenses.definition: stunned or confused and slow to react (as from blows or drunkenness or exhaustion)

cases.rationale: The adjective explicitly includes confused cognition.

allowedSenses.definition: having tonality; i.e. tones and chords organized in relation to one tone such as a keynote or tonic

cases.rationale: The quality explicitly describes an organized relationship of musical tones.

allowedSenses.definition: systematic investigation to establish facts
attempt to find out in a systematically and scientific manner

cases.rationale: Systematic investigation is an expressly methodical activity, not a field of study.

allowedSenses.definition: the act of scanning; systematic examination of a prescribed region

cases.rationale: The source defines the activity as systematic examination.

allowedSenses.definition: a violent commotion or disturbance

cases.rationale: The figurative commotion sense reinforces disorder independently of weather.

allowedSenses.definition: twist together or entwine into a confusing mass

cases.rationale: A confusing mass explicitly expresses disarray.

allowedSenses.definition: twist together or entwine into a confusing mass

cases.rationale: The verb explicitly entwines into a confusing mass.

allowedSenses.definition: make more complicated or confused through entanglements

cases.rationale: The verb explicitly creates confusion.

allowedSenses.definition: a noisy riotous fight

cases.rationale: A riotous fight is a disorderly disturbance.

allowedSenses.definition: lacking orderly continuity

cases.rationale: Lacking orderly continuity reinforces disorder; negation must not be lost.

allowedSenses.definition: in a random manner

cases.rationale: The adverb retains the random lack-of-order quality.

allowedSenses.definition: marked by peace and prosperity

cases.rationale: This adjective explicitly denotes peace, not the physical color.

allowedSenses.definition: settle by agreement
contrive (a plan) by mutual agreement

cases.rationale: The verbs settle by agreement and jointly devise a plan.

allowedSenses.definition: neat and smart in appearance; well cared for
give a neat appearance to

cases.rationale: Both the tidy adjective and neatening verb directly express order.

allowedSenses.definition: with neatness

cases.rationale: Neatness retains its meaning in an adverb.

allowedSenses.definition: acting in a manner that is gentle and mild and even-tempered

cases.rationale: The source explicitly includes an even temper.

allowedSenses.definition: lessen the intensity of; temper; hold in restraint; hold or keep within limits

cases.rationale: The verb explicitly keeps within limits, regulating rather than merely describing an average.

allowedSenses.definition: bring into consonance, harmony, or accord while making music or singing

cases.rationale: The verb directly creates harmony.

allowedSenses.definition: blend or harmonize

cases.rationale: The admitted GO harmony sense applies to its past participle; disappearance does not justify the bonus.

allowedSenses.definition: arrange attractively

cases.rationale: The admitted arranging sense applies to its past participle.

allowedSenses.definition: designate or schedule

cases.rationale: The scheduling verb organizes time; the physical slate does not.

allowedSenses.definition: assign a time slot

cases.rationale: Assigning a time slot organizes time; relative status alone does not.

allowedSenses.definition: in a legible manner

cases.rationale: Legibility expresses clarity of written communication.

allowedSenses.definition: with good sense or in a reasonable or intelligent manner

cases.rationale: The adverb explicitly describes reasonable, intelligent thought.

allowedSenses.definition: provide interlinear explanations for words or phrases

cases.rationale: The word-explaining verb clarifies meaning; shine does not.

allowedSenses.definition: planning prudently for the future

cases.rationale: The prudent-planning sense supports organization, independently of physical length.

allowedSenses.definition: the perception of pleasant arrangements of musical notes

cases.rationale: This source denotes the perception of an arranged musical pattern.
A viewpoint by itself does not express order or clarity.
The status of a relationship does not specify agreement or harmony.
A generic authoritative instruction can have any content and need not organize anything.
A DNA sequence is a physical object with structure, not the quality of order.
Packing to capacity need not produce order.
A varied collection need not be orderly.
A relative ordinal position does not itself mean orderliness.
Birth-order position does not itself mean orderliness.

allowedSenses.definition: be a mystery or bewildering to

cases.rationale: The direct bewildering sense wins under the fixed reinforcement precedence despite a separate rhythmic sense.

allowedSenses.definition: be a mystery or bewildering to

cases.rationale: The inflected bewildering verb preserves the same meaning.

allowedSenses.definition: be a mystery or bewildering to

cases.rationale: The verb has an explicit bewildering reading, separate from obtaining things.

allowedSenses.definition: be a mystery or bewildering to

cases.rationale: The same bewildering sense applies to the inflection.

allowedSenses.definition: not carefully arranged in a package

cases.rationale: The exact adjective negates careful arrangement, rather than merely describing low density.

allowedSenses.definition: a mythical bird said to breed at the time of the winter solstice in a nest floating on the sea and to have the power of calming the winds and waves

cases.rationale: Player-reported miss: the mythical birds explicitly calm winds and waves. This valid plural counters through its own noun meaning, not an inherited adjective label.
